correctness.rationale: Graph definitions and all trace masks are deterministic and finite. Independently enumerated every size-1..4 support for each 16-vertex graph using separate adjacency/bit trace construction; got 16,120,288,0 for rook; 16,120,224,0 for Shrikhande; open 16,120,320,0 each. A shattered 4-set would require 16 distinct centers with 8 incidences per vertex, impossible because closed degree=7; exhaustive enumeration adds exact confirmation.
residual_risks: Finite numerical tests do not substitute for infinite analytic proof; source proof independently examined.
